name: robots/arise-initiative__robosuite-task-zoo
title: robosuite Task Zoo HammerPlace environment
intro: robosuite Task Zoo HammerPlace environment, adapted from arise-initiative/robosuite-task-zoo. It reads `observation`, `tick`, `episode`, `seed` and 2 more; runs `reset_world` and `step`. `reset_world`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
